thread:
Priya: Heads-up: prepping a 3-step re-engagement nurture for trial signups who went quiet after day 7. Goal: push to API usage or book a demo. Need subject options, cadence, and suppression rules. Plan draft below.
Ana: Love it. Quick Q: are we including users who only created an account but never verified email?
Priya: Exclude unverified by default. Segment = verified trials with zero API usage after 7 days.
Sam: Subject ideas for step 1 (reminder):
- "Still testing Redwood? Quick tips to get started"
- "Your trial: 2 min to meaningful predictions"
- "Start sending requests — example prompts inside"
I prefer the third for dev clarity.
Marisol: Add preheader: "Code snippets, sample prompts, and a 1-click start". Also let's include a tiny TL;DR badge: "3 min read" at top.
Dev: Suppression rules: no sends to users who unsubscribed, customers on Dedicated trial, or anyone contacted by AE in the last 14 days. SQL sample for segment below:
```sql
SELECT id, email
FROM users
WHERE verified = true
  AND cohort = 'trial'
  AND created_at <= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND api_calls = 0
  AND unsubscribed = false
  AND trial_tag != 'dedicated-migration'
  AND id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM ae_touch_events WHERE event_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days');
```
Priya: Perfect. Cadence: step 1 at day 7, step 2 (value email w/ mini-case) at day 10, step 3 (last chance + demo CTA) at day 14. Anything else?
Ana: A/B idea: subject variant for step 1 — variant A = product-first ("Start sending requests — example prompts inside"), variant B = outcome-first ("Get reliable predictions in minutes"). Send variant to 15% holdout for 72h. Key metric = API activation rate.
Sam: Track opens, CTR to quickstart, and API activation within 7 days. Also include a tiny UTM for attribution: utm_campaign=trial-nurture-may2026.
Marisol: Creative note: include 1 code snippet block, one animated gif showing a request -> response, and a one-line customer quote. We have permission from Solace to use a short quote.
Dev: Scheduling/windows: send between 9-11am local time for recipients; fallback to 10am PST for users without TZ info. Also ramp control: start at 20% volume to monitor bounce/spam signals, ramp to 100% after 24h if health looks good.
Priya: Great. Who owns the copy finalization? Marisol will do copy, Sam will review, Dev runs segment + sample CSV.
LaunchBot: Campaign draft created: id=20260503-trial-nurture. Draft scheduled at 2026-05-03T16:00:00Z pending final approval.
Marisol: I'll post the final copy here by EOD. Please :thumbsup: or flag edits.
Ana: :thumbsup:
Sam: :thumbsup:
